reason: I lost a $9,000 kitchen job last month because a quote sat there, and the day 1, 3, 7, 14 text follow-up is exactly what I never do on my own. The demo counts my missed calls first and the 60-day refund covers the setup, so the downside is small next to one saved job.
objection: $2,000 up front is real money for me, and I'm afraid it says something wrong to a customer or books a bad time and I lose them. I also don't know if a one-man outfit will still be around and watching it in six months.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo call log shows only a handful of missed calls, or the recorded test calls sound off in Québec French, I walk away. A refund on the monthly fee too, not just the setup, would make it an easy yes.
